description: This file contains an Android Activity implementation demonstrating the usage of TextToSpeech API for converting text to speech. It handles initialization, language settings, user interaction, and resource cleanup related to TextToSpeech functionality.

classes.name: TextToSpeechActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity demonstrating text-to-speech features, including initialization, language setting, and speaking random greetings.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Sets up the activity UI, initializes the TextToSpeech engine, and sets a click listener on the button.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources by stopping and shutting down the TextToSpeech engine.

methods.name: onInit
methods.description: Handles the completion of TextToSpeech engine initialization, setting language preferences, and enabling user interaction.

methods.name: sayHello
methods.description: Selects a random greeting from a predefined list and invokes the TTS engine to speak it.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method that initializes UI components and the TextToSpeech engine.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Lifecycle method that shuts down the TextToSpeech engine to free resources.

methods.name: onInit
methods.description: Callback for when TextToSpeech initialization completes; sets language and updates UI.
